A '''spaceport''' was built by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Osnoe]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was built by the Republic to help pay for the conflict by profiting from trade in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Boorka]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on Tatooine, was displeased by the spaceport's presence, and requested [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] to destroy it in exchange for information he possessed, resulting in the spaceport destruction.
